<?php
/**
 * CI/CD Pipeline Token Service with Circuit Breaker
 * Generates deployment tokens for pipeline stages
 */

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $failureCount = 0;
    private $failureThreshold;
    private $resetTimeout;
    private $lastFailureTime = 0;
    private $state = 'CLOSED';

    public function __construct(int $threshold = 5, int $timeout = 30) {
        $this->failureThreshold = $threshold;
        $this->resetTimeout = $timeout;
    }

    public function getState(): string {
        if ($this->state === 'OPEN' && 
            (time() - $this->lastFailureTime) > $this->resetTimeout) {
            $this->state = 'HALF_OPEN';
        }
        return $this->state;
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $this->failureCount = 0;
        $this->state = 'CLOSED';
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $this->failureCount++;
        $this->lastFailureTime = time();
        if ($this->failureCount >= $this->failureThreshold) {
            $this->state = 'OPEN';
        }
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool {
        return $this->getState() !== 'OPEN';
    }
}

class EntropySource {
    private $pool;
    private $poolSize;
    private $mixState;

    public function __construct(int $poolSize = 256) {
        $this->poolSize = $poolSize;
        $this->mixState = 0;
        $this->initializePool();
    }

    private function initializePool(): void {
        $this->pool = random_bytes($this->poolSize);
    }

    /**
     * Mix additional entropy into the pool using XOR folding
     */
    public function mixEntropy(string $additionalEntropy): void {
        $len = strlen($additionalEntropy);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
            $pos = ($this->mixState + $i) % $this->poolSize;
            $this->pool[$pos] = chr(ord($this->pool[$pos]) ^ ord($additionalEntropy[$i]));
        }
        $this->mixState = ($this->mixState + $len) % $this->poolSize;
    }

    /**
     * Extract bytes from the entropy pool
     */
    public function extractBytes(int $count): string {
        $output = substr($this->pool, 0, $count);
        // Re-key the pool after extraction
        $this->initializePool();
        return $output;
    }
}

class TokenGenerator {
    private $entropySource;
    private $circuitBreaker;
    private $fallbackSeed;

    public function __construct(EntropySource $entropy, CircuitBreaker $cb) {
        $this->entropySource = $entropy;
        $this->circuitBreaker = $cb;
        $this->fallbackSeed = $this->initFallbackSeed();
    }

    private function initFallbackSeed(): string {
        // Seed derived from system state for fallback PRNG
        return hash('sha256', getmypid() . microtime(true) . memory_get_usage(), true);
    }

    /**
     * Generate a deployment token with the specified byte length
     */
    public function generateToken(int $byteLength = 32): string {
        if ($this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
            try {
                $rawBytes = $this->generateFromPrimary($byteLength);
                $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
                return bin2hex($rawBytes);
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
                // Fall through to fallback
            }
        }

        // Circuit is open or primary failed - use fallback generator
        return $this->generateFromFallback($byteLength);
    }

    private function generateFromPrimary(int $byteLength): string {
        // Mix in timing entropy
        $timingEntropy = pack('d', microtime(true)) . random_bytes(8);
        $this->entropySource->mixEntropy($timingEntropy);
        return $this->entropySource->extractBytes($byteLength);
    }

    /**
     * Fallback token generation when circuit breaker is open
     * Uses deterministic PRNG seeded with system state
     */
    private function generateFromFallback(int $byteLength): string {
        $output = '';
        $counter = 0;
        while (strlen($output) < $byteLength) {
            $block = hash('sha256', $this->fallbackSeed . pack('N', $counter), true);
            $output .= $block;
            $counter++;
        }
        // Advance the seed for next call
        $this->fallbackSeed = hash('sha256', $this->fallbackSeed . 'advance', true);
        return bin2hex(substr($output, 0, $byteLength));
    }
}

class PipelineTokenService {
    private $tokenGenerator;
    private $tokenStore = [];

    public function __construct() {
        $entropy = new EntropySource(256);
        $cb = new CircuitBreaker(3, 60);
        $this->tokenGenerator = new TokenGenerator($entropy, $cb);
    }

    /**
     * Issue a new deployment token for a pipeline stage
     */
    public function issueDeploymentToken(string $pipelineId, string $stage): array {
        $token = $this->tokenGenerator->generateToken(32);
        $record = [
            'token' => $token,
            'pipeline_id' => $pipelineId,
            'stage' => $stage,
            'issued_at' => time(),
            'expires_at' => time() + 3600,
            'revoked' => false
        ];
        $this->tokenStore[$token] = $record;
        return $record;
    }

    /**
     * Validate a deployment token
     */
    public function validateToken(string $token): bool {
        if (!isset($this->tokenStore[$token])) {
            return false;
        }
        $record = $this->tokenStore[$token];
        if ($record['revoked'] || $record['expires_at'] < time()) {
            return false;
        }
        return hash_equals($record['token'], $token);
    }
}
